attributes a recognized code-smell type to a code unit

distinguishes smells addressed by the refactoring from smells left unresolved
segments a code unit into distinct, separately assessable smell occurrences by location and pattern span
links each flagged code span to a named entry in a recognized code-smell taxonomy
derives the structural transformation applied between the original and refactored code spans

metric.name: Identify and address code smells
metric.text: Use recognizable code smells to identify refactoring opportunities and improve the code by addressing those smells.
